feedback: Say how sick the patient is. The message never mentions the grey colour, sweating, tight chest, or speech of only a few words. Put that right after the header, because it tells the crew this is a possible cardiac or severe breathing emergency.

Remove details the building data doesn't support. There are no suite numbers (705, 710, 725), no stretcher-fit information for the freight car, and no occupancy schedule behind "daytime". Say "suite not on record" and "freight car on record, size unknown".

Cover the first needs. You gave the elevator and a vague suite, and said nothing about an air-quality cause on the floor. The caller also asked whether to go down and meet the crew, and the message doesn't answer that.
